messages:
Priya: Kicking off the monthly recurrence playbook sync. Observed spike in recurring incidents last 6 weeks — looks like two dominant themes: autoscaler edge cases + KV-cache churn. Need owners + timelines for remediation. Thoughts?

Jordan: +1. Want a compact list of top causes and proposed fixes so we can hand to infra/product. Can we rank by customer impact (error rate) and frequency? :eyes:

Aya: Quick data point — from 2026-02-01 to 2026-03-22 we had 9 incidents flagged as 'recurrence'. 5 related to autoscale/scale-down races, 3 to cache eviction causing 502s, 1 misc config drift. Will attach short table in follow-up.

Mike: For autoscaler: we've seen scale-down timers too aggressive when bursty traffic overlaps with backup jobs. Proposed short-term mitigation: increase graceful window from 30s -> 90s for affected pools. Long-term: add activity-based pause during scheduled backups. Owner: Mike. ETA: 2 weeks for short-term, 8 weeks for long-term.

Sofia: For KV cache churn: root cause seems to be per-request batch size variation leading to frequent KV invalidations + mem pressure on smaller hosts. Proposed fix: enforce batch-size cap on edge and add prefix caching for hot prefixes. Owner: Sofia + eng-runtime. ETA: 3 weeks.

oncall-bot: incident-bot created: #INC-2026-1103 "KV cache eviction cascade" (linked to this thread)

Priya: OK, let's translate proposals into action items and owners. Please confirm you accept ownership, and paste any small rollouts/QA steps here. We'll track in the recurrence board. :thumbsup:

Mike: accepting ownership for autoscaler short-term. Rollout plan: dev -> canary (5%) -> 25% -> 100% over 48h. Run canary during low-traffic window. QA: synthetic load test + cluster warmup smoke tests.

Sofia: accepting ownership for KV cache plan. Small rollout: config flag gated on runtime, enable for one region, monitor cache hit rate + 502 rate. Will add perf counters.

Jordan: I'll own tracking and customer-impact classification. I'll add a heatmap to the recurrence board and link each action item to the postmortems. ETA: 1 week to populate and assign.

Aya: Adding raw numbers here (quick):
```
recurrence_summary: {
  total_incidents: 9,
  autoscaler_related: 5,
  cache_related: 3,
  other: 1
}
most_affected_services: [inference-runtime, routing-proxy]
```

Priya: Good. Can we make a minimal playbook entry for "scale-down race" and "cache-eviction cascade" so oncall has steps to mitigate? Even a checklist helps.

Sofia: Draft playbook checklist for cache-eviction cascade: 
- switch cache to read-only (if supported)
- increase instance sizes for region
- enable temp-prefix-caching flag
- roll back new client batch-size changes
(Will paste formal doc later)

Mike: Draft playbook for scale-down race: 
- increase graceful window to 90s
- temporarily disable aggressive downscaling policy for pool X
- re-route critical traffic to warm pool Y
- if incident persists, scale up nodes manually and open incident chat

Priya: Nice. Let's capture explicit action items (single-line) so the recurrence board can pick them up. Use this format: "owner | short action | ETA"

Sofia: "Sofia | implement batch-size cap + prefix caching flag | 2026-04-12"

Mike: "Mike | increase graceful window (prod canary) + rollout plan | 2026-04-05"

Jordan: "Jordan | populate recurrence heatmap & link postmortems | 2026-03-29"

Priya: "Priya | schedule follow-up sync & verify playbooks posted | 2026-03-30"

Aya: Quick command I used to pull incidents:
```
incidents search --tag recurrence --since 2026-02-01 --fields ts,service,summary | sort -r
```

Sofia: tagging the related postmortems in the recurrence board now. Will add monitoring dashboards (cache hit rate, 5xx rate) and set low-threshold alerts.

Priya: Thanks. For visibility: I'll post the action list to the all-hands incident channel after this so execs see timelines. Also want to ensure we don't have the same owners for >5 remediation tasks each. If someone's overloaded, reassign.

Jordan: Noted. If anybody needs to shift ownership ping me. I can help rebalance.

Mike: One more note — can we add a gated config rollout tool to make canaries easier for infra teams? Filed infra request: #INFRA-722.

Priya: Perfect. Next steps: owners confirm in-thread (done), Jordan will update board (ETA 3/29), follow-up sync scheduled 2026-03-30 10:00 PT. Closing thread for now, will reopen if blockers appear. :white_check_mark:
